morgen.a: Good morning{namek}! Did you sleep well?
morgen.b: Moooorning! I've been waiting for you!
morgen.c: Good morning! Today's going to be a good day, I can feel it!
morgen.vertraut_a: Good morning{namek}! {tage} days of us already — and every morning is better with you.
morgen.beste_a: There's my favorite person! Good morning!
morgen.beste_b: Morning, you! With you I don't have to explain anything. You just know me.

mittag.a: Hey{namek}! I'm getting a little hungry…
mittag.b: Hello you! So glad you're here!

nachmittag.a: Hey{namek}! How's your day been so far?
nachmittag.b: Heeey! Perfect time for the two of us!

abend.a: Good evening{namek}! Shall we get cozy?
abend.b: Hello you! The evening is ours!
abend.vertraut_a: Good evening{namek}! Our evening ritual, hm? I like that.
abend.beste_a: Evening, you. Sofa, the two of us — like always?

nacht.a: You're still awake{namek}…? Me too. Shhh.
nacht.b: Midnight visit! That stays our secret.

gefreut.a: There you are! I was thinking about you!
gefreut.b: Yay, you're back! What are we doing today?
gefreut.beste_a: There you are! Without you this place is only half as nice. Honestly.

eingeschnappt.a: Hmpf. You were gone a LONG time. … Fine, I missed you anyway.
eingeschnappt.b: I'm sulking. A little. Okay, done sulking — glad you're here!

vermisst.a: YOU'RE BACK!! I missed you sooo much!
vermisst.b: Finally! I looked out the window every day to see if you were coming!

geburtstag_spieler.b: Happy birthday, {name}! Today we celebrate YOU!

geburtstag_gooby.a: Today is MY birthday! Remember when I moved in?
geburtstag_gooby.b: It's my birthday!! Is there… cake?

jubilaeum.a: You know what? We've known each other for {tage} days now! Nice, right?
jubilaeum.b: {tage} days, the two of us! Here's to many, many more!

ritual.neujahr: Happy New Year!! This year is going to be OUR year!
ritual.ostern: Happy Easter! I looked for eggs everywhere… none behind the sofa.
ritual.halloween: Boo! … Did I scare you? A LITTLE? Happy Halloween!
ritual.nikolaus: St. Nick's day! I polished my shoe. Just in case.
ritual.heiligabend: Christmas Eve!! I'm SO excited. Can you hear the bells?
ritual.weihnachten: Merry Christmas! The best present is you anyway.
ritual.silvester: New Year's Eve! Let's stay up until midnight… or try to.
ritual.erster_schnee: SNOW!! The first snow!! Look, LOOK!!

gutenacht.a: I'm getting sleeeepy… Will you tell me one more thing before I sleep?
gutenacht.b: Yawn… Good night, you. Dream something nice about us.

regen.a: It's raining… I like the sound on the window.
regen.b: Pitter, patter… Good thing we're inside, right?

wetter.gewitter: Was that THUNDER?! I-I'm not scared. Almost not.
wetter.schnee: It's snowing again! Every flake is different, did you know that?

erinnerung.rekord: Remember your record in {spiel}? {punkte} points! That was pretty good!
erinnerung.urlaub: Remember when we went on vacation? {ziel} was so beautiful!
erinnerung.kitzeln: You've tickled me {anzahl} times already. I'm counting. Hehe.
erinnerung.garten: {anzahl} harvests! Our garden is the best.
erinnerung.streak: {tage} days in a row together! You and me, we're a team.
erinnerung.funkelpark: Remember the theme park? {anzahl} visits! I still get dizzy.
erinnerung.spielzeit: We've already spent {stunden} hours together. The best ones!
erinnerung.vorliebe_spiel: I think {spiel} is OUR game. You always light up the most playing it!
erinnerung.vorliebe_essen: You bring me {essen} most of all, I've noticed. Tastes the best, too.
erinnerung.goobye_markttag: Remember our first market day at Goo and Bye? Uncle Alwin bought EXACTLY ONE carrot. I was so proud of us!
erinnerung.goobye_umsatz: {tage} market days at our little store and already {muenzen} coins in the till! I helped count. Twice.
erinnerung.goobye_lieferwagen: Remember when our delivery van arrived? I honked. With my mouth, but from the heart.
erinnerung.mcgooby_schichten: {anzahl} shifts at McGooby already! Sometimes I dream of fries. Okay… more than sometimes.
erinnerung.mcgooby_bestwert: Remember your best McGooby shift? {punkte} points! The trays were practically flying.
erinnerung.mcgooby_perfekt: Your McGooby shift without a single slip — not ONE mistake! I almost lost my cap out of pure pride.
erinnerung.ranch_fund: Remember when we discovered {ort}? My ears still tingle when I think about it.
erinnerung.ranch_funde: {anzahl} secret spots found on the ranch! The two of us are real explorers.
erinnerung.ranch_karte: Remember poring over the explorer map together? I made a dog-ear in it. Sorry.
erinnerung.geist_rekord: Your ghost best run in {spiel}: {punkte} points! Your ghost probably practices in secret, but YOU are faster.
erinnerung.geist_sammlung: {anzahl} ghost best runs already! A whole ghost gang — and every single one is YOU.
erinnerung.heimkehr: Remember when I came home from {ziel}? The hug was the very best part of the whole vacation.
erinnerung.mitbringsel: Our souvenir corner! {anzahl} treasures already. Each one tells a little journey when you look at it.
erinnerung.spotlight_a: Remember your game of the day at the arcade? Extra coins! I applauded very quietly.
erinnerung.spotlight_b: The arcade spotlight! You just went and got the daily bonus. You're still my favorite player.

aufraeumen.a: Just tidying up a bit. A place for everything!

idle.fernsehen: Shhh, the exciting part is coming up!
idle.fenster: Just checking what's going on outside…
idle.tanzen: This song!! I HAVE to dance!
idle.lieblingsplatz: My favorite spot. {moebel} and I, we get each other.

sup.sofa_fund: LOOK! Under the sofa! Coins! They're ours now!

traum.a: Zzz… no… YOU are the cookie…
traum.b: Zzz… five more minutes, Mr. Carrot…

sup.turm: I built a TOWER! I call it… Towery.
sup.winken: Hello! Yes, YOU there! I can see you! *wave*

moebel_neu.a: Oooh, {moebel}! Brand new! I already tested it — very good!
moebel_neu.b: {moebel}! It suits us, don't you think?

geschenk.a: Mmmh! Thank you!! You just know what I like!

kommentar.lieblingsessen: {essen}!! My absolute FAVORITE! How did you know?

traurig.a: …it's okay. I'm just glad when you're here.
traurig.b: *sigh* … Would you stay with me for a bit?

tipp.kitzlig: Hihihi!! Stop it — no, KEEP GOING — no, hihi!!
tipp.schwindelig: Phew… I'm all dizzy… but that was fun.

frage.geburtstag: Hey… when is your birthday, actually? I want to remember it!

geburtstag_panel.danke: {tag}.{monat}. — saved! I will NEVER forget it!

wunsch.funkelpark: You know what? I've always wanted to visit the sparkle park. Do the lights REALLY sparkle there?
wunsch.funkelpark_erfuellt: Remember how I dreamed about the sparkle park? We REALLY went! Thank you!
wunsch.urlaub: I've always wanted to travel. Pack a suitcase once and just go!
wunsch.urlaub_erfuellt: We really went on vacation! I talked about it — and then we actually WENT!
wunsch.streak7: I wish we could see each other seven days in a row. A whole week of us!
wunsch.streak7_erfuellt: Seven days in a row! I wished for it, and you made it come true.
wunsch.kissenturm: I've always wanted to build a HUGE pillow tower. One day I'll dare!
wunsch.kissenturm_erfuellt: I built it! The pillow tower! Just like I always wanted!

absicht.hunger_a: Just taking a tiny peek at what's in the fridge…
absicht.hunger_b: My tummy is rumbling a little. Can you hear it too?
absicht.langeweile_a: I'm sooo bored… Will you play with me?
absicht.langeweile_b: I'll find something to do. Or… do you have an idea?
absicht.muede_a: I'm tired… The bed looks so cozy…
absicht.muede_b: Yaaawn… Just lying down for a bit. Just a bit.
absicht.dreckig_a: I feel a little sticky. Bath time?
absicht.regen_a: It's raining… I'll sit by the window and watch the drops.

schreck.b: Yikes!! My heart is pounding up to my ears!

freude.a: Hehe! Today is simply a good day!
freude.b: That makes me happy, you know?

ueberraschung.a: Oh!! I did NOT expect that!

verlegenheit.b: T-that wasn't what it looked like…

traurigkeit.a: I'm feeling a bit small right now…
traurigkeit.b: Could you stay with me for a moment…?

neugier.b: I need a closer look at this!

stolz.a: Did you see that? THAT WAS ME!

angst.a: I-is somebody there…? It's so dark…

verliebtheit.a: My FAVORITE food! You know me so well!
verliebtheit.b: I… I think this is love.
